summary.quantification_method: Isobaric tandem mass tags (TMT) reporter ion intensity

quantification_strategy: Isobaric tandem mass tags (TMT) reporter ion intensity

acquisition: Top-10 most intensive precursor ions were selected for MS/MS using alternating ETD and higher energy collision dissociation (HCD)
labeling: static TMT6 labeling on N-terminal and Lys (229.1629 Da)
quantification: The intensities of all six TMT reporter ions were extracted using MASIC software
Relative peptide/protein abundance was then calculated as the ratio of sample abundance to abundance of the pooled reference
enrichment: Enrichment of O-GlcNAc peptide from the fractions followed the CEPC method
workflow_hints: dynamic O-GlcNAcylation on Ser and Thr (502.2023 Da)
An Ascore >13 was required for confident O-GlcNAc site assignment

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The assay specifically targets O-GlcNAcylation using a chemoenzymatic photocleavage (CEPC) method. While O-GlcNAc is a specific type of glycosylation, it is mapped to the glycoproteome enrichment ontology (PPA:0000293) and mod_glyco modifier based on the provided ontology context.

noncellular_sources: The grey matter (~0.1 g) of the mid frontal gyrus of each sample was homogenized
scope: chemoenzymatic photocleavage enrichment and liquid chromatography coupled to mass spectrometry

the fractionated peptides (~300 μg) were dried in vacuum and re-suspended... the peptides were reacted with 1 mM biotin-PEG-PC-alkyne... incubated with NeutrAvidin agarose resin (Pierce) for 2 h at RT
The O-GlcNAc peptides were released from the resin by 365 nm UV radiation for 25 min. One fourth of the enriched sample was injected for LC-MS/MS analysis.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The primary analysis focused on O-GlcNAc peptides enriched via chemoenzymatic photocleavage (CEPC) and NeutrAvidin affinity capture, which fits the 'affinity-purified complex scope'. A small aliquot of unenriched peptides was used for global protein quantification, but the core objective and result set are based on the enriched subproteome.
